summary: Made pmcro-dotnet installable. Added .codex-plugin/plugin.json, version.json in Nerdbank pathspec form, README.md, the clean-architecture-generic-repository SKILL.md and references/layering.md, added pmcro-dotnet to GOVERNED_PLUGINS in validate_host_boundary.py, and registered it in all five marketplace manifests. Also fixed a defect found on the starting verification rather than introduced by it: .pmcro/state/ was covered by MANIFEST.sha256, so opening a claim or firing the heartbeat hook made the content manifest report itself stale during ordinary work. Runtime state is now excluded alongside .pmcro/queue/, for the reason already recorded there.
